v1.3.4 Hotfix
🐛 Dialogue Backlog Duplicate Messages: Live Mode no longer adds the same Foundry chat message to the Dialogue Backlog multiple times when several clients are connected or a player joins after the session starts.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.3.4
announcement.content:
Visual Novel Maker v1.3.4 fixes duplicate Dialogue Backlog entries in Live Mode.

  • Each Foundry chat message is now added once, including sessions with several connected clients or players joining after Live Mode starts.
